contract.task_clause:
Which of the following questions can a student ask to best determine whether an author is using the persuasive technique of pathos in a passage?
Option A: Does the author use tone and style to convey authority on the subject to the audience?
Option B: Does the author use credible and reliable sources to convince the audience of the argument?
Option C: Does the author use facts and sound reasoning to substantiate claims made to the audience?
Option D: Does the author use personal connections and stories to appeal to the audience's emotions?
